messages:
sam_g: Hey team — customer says our SDK estimate is ~240 tokens lower than what showed up on their invoice for the same request. Repro below, short thread.

sam_g: Repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\n    "model":"open-variant-3b",\n    "messages":[\n      {"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},\n      {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the attached log"}\n    ],\n    "stream": false\n  }'\n```

sam_g: SDK (js-sdk v0.14.2) estimator reported: prompt=180 tokens, completion=120 tokens, total_estimate=300.
sam_g: Invoice / metering shows: total=540 tokens. Delta ~= +240 tokens.

marta: Thanks. Do you have the request_id or trace id from the API response? and whether the request triggered any function/tool calls?

sam_g: request_id=rid_01234567, no explicit function call in our code. Customer sent plain user content. I grabbed the server response headers and trace (redacted):
```
x-request-id: rid_01234567
x-metering-hint: tool_call_injected
```

sam_g: Also attached a small log snippet from server: "assistant function_call formatted_output called" (seems like a sidecar formatted the output).

metering-bot: Ticket created: BILL-4873. Assigned to metering-team.

nick: quick question — is the SDK estimator running token counts on the pre-serialized function arguments or just on messages array?

sam_g: SDK estimator only tokenizes the messages array the app passes in (system + user + assistant). It does not introspect server-inserted function_call payloads or any post-processing.

marta: OK that matches hypothesis: server inserted a hidden assistant->function message (with JSON args) for formatting, and metering counts that serialized JSON. SDK never saw it, so estimate undercounts. Can you paste sample of the tool payload (sanitized)?

sam_g: Snippet from sidecar logs (sanitized):
```json
{\"assistant\":\"function_call\",\"name\":\"format_log\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"level\\\":\\\"error\\\",\\\"lines\\\":[\\\"...\\\"]}\"}
```

marta: That JSON blob can be large — if the server serialized the whole log into a function argument, that would explain +200–400 tokens.

elaine: Metering update: confirmed root cause for rid_01234567 — a server-side formatting function was invoked by the response pipeline and the function arguments were included in metering. SDK estimation path didn't include the server-injected assistant message + function arguments, so it under-reported. Also found a secondary issue: streaming stop sequences were double-counted in some older metering runs (fixed last week).

elaine: Action items:
- metering team will add a mitigation to include a `x-metering-scope` header in responses that indicates "server-inserted-content" so SDKs can surface a warning. (ETA: 3 business days)
- SDKs: we'll ship an estimator patch to optionally add a conservative allowance for server-inserted tool tokens if header present (ETA: next SDK release).
- Billing: we will treat this class of deltas as expected behavior for now (server-side content is billable). If customers need an immediate remedy, they can request an itemized metering export and we can review individual requests.

sam_g: Helpful — can you confirm whether customers can opt out of the server formatting sidecar?

elaine: For now there's a per-tenant flag on the pipeline (opt-out available for enterprise customers) — ops can toggle for that org. I'll send the org-level toggle to support privately.

marta: For the ticket, I'll add reproduction steps, the request id, and the suggestion to opt-out if they want to avoid server-inserted tokens.

sam_g: I'll relay to the customer and ask if they want the opt-out. Thanks. :thumbsup:

marta: Marking this thread for follow-up after metering header rollout.

metering-bot: BILL-4873 updated: label=investigating, priority=high.

sam_g: closing loop on my side once customer confirms.

elaine: tl;dr — invoice includes server-inserted assistant/function tokens (billable). SDK estimate only covered the client-sent messages. We'll add headers/SDK heuristics and doc guidance to avoid future surprises.

sam_g: Great, please ping this thread when headers are live so I can notify the customer.
